title: Magical Teapot Orb
description: A glowing teal teapot character with a cheerful smiling face and large eyes floats inside a transparent spherical energy field. The sphere contains a massive glowing orange bear paw with sharp claws and turquoise paw pads, surrounded by floating rock fragments and vibrant purple and cyan electrical arcs.
prompt: A cheerful turquoise teapot with a smiling cartoon face and large expressive eyes floats inside a transparent glowing orb. Inside the orb is a giant glowing orange bear paw with sharp claws and turquoise paw pads. Purple and cyan lightning arcs crackle throughout the sphere, with floating rock fragments. The entire scene radiates magical energy against a dark space background with radiating purple light beams.
